stem: The depth \(D(t)\), in centimeters, of the water in a garden pond \(t\) hours after a pump is switched on is given by \(D(t) = 150 - kt\), where \(k\) is a constant. While the pump runs, the depth of the water decreases by 3.6 centimeters every 45 minutes. What is the value of \(k\)?
solution: The constant \(k\) is the decrease in depth per hour, because \(t\) is measured in hours.
verify:
k = Rational('3.6') / Rational(45, 60)
assert k == Rational(24, 5)
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == k and len(spr_answers) == 1
t = symbols('t')
D = 150 - k*t
assert D.subs(t, 0) - D.subs(t, Rational(3, 4)) == Rational('3.6')
